# LensLoop — Contact Lens Timer & Replacement Reminder (iOS + watchOS)

> LensLoop tracks contact lens replacement per eye (daily, bi-weekly, monthly or custom cycles), sends reminders, logs daily eye comfort to reveal trends, and tracks accessories (case, drops, solution). Includes Home/Lock Screen widgets and Apple Watch complications. Unlimited lens tracking is free with no ads; Pro adds accessories, widgets, Watch and trends (3-day trial or lifetime purchase). App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6790209362
